product_metadata.title: magic bullet Blender, Small, Black, 11 Piece Set
features: The Magic Bullet lets you blend, mix, and chop your favorite foods in seconds. Hassle-free cleaning – simply twist off the blade, rise with soap and water, and put the cups in the top rack of the dishwasher.
High-torque 250-watt motor powers the machine’s versatility. There’s no limit to the sauces, dips, drinks and snacks you can create.
Included: (1) 250W motor base, (1) cross-blade, (1) tall cup, (1) short cup, (1) party mug, (2) lip rings, (2) Stay-Fresh resealable lids, (1) to-go lid and 10-second recipe guide.
Cross blade is made from stainless steel and cups are made from super-durable, BPA-free.
Hassle-free cleaning - simply twist off the blade, rinse with soap and water, and put the cups in the top rack of the dishwasher. This item comes with a 1 year Limited Warranty.
Included Components: Cooks' Tools, Cream Makers & Chargers, Electric-Blenders
description: Meet the countertop helper that started it all. The Magic Bullet chops, blends, and mixes to create an endless array of delectable dishes in seconds.
